name: HERMES_SCORE_WEIGHTS_STORE_20261107
comment: ANCHOR: HERMES_SCORE_WEIGHTS_STORE_20261107 — LQ-20261107-55 / LQ-20261107-187. The tuner wrote its
learned factor weights into config/hermes_score_weights.yaml inside the release directory, so every
promote replaced them with the v9 git seed: the served weights stayed at 2026-08-13 while the newest
surviving learned graft was v20 (2026-11-01), and 42 audited grafts were lost. The fix moves the live
store to config_documents (system of record) with a persistent-state mirror written after the DB; the
release YAML is a read-only seed. This file pins the ladder (DB > mirror > seed), that an unreadable
tier is named and skipped rather than flattened into a plausible default, that the DB is written before
the mirror, that the seed is never written, and that every reader (scorer, calibration, outcome
learning, self-tune writer) resolves through the store.
Registered because a new pytest file that no gate names is not run by CI (check_test_coverage --fail-on-new).
